reviews.comment:
Pase a las 5 de la mañana del 8 de enero, un solo playero, ensima llega camión supongo de un campo a llevar varios tachos de 200 lts. De diésel, salgo temprano para llegar temprano, y pierdo media hora acá, ensima no tiene débito, solo efectivo. Menos mal que es estación ACA

(Translated by Google)
I went by at 5 AM on January 8th, there was only one attendant, and on top of that, a truck arrived, presumably from a farm, to deliver several 200-liter drums of diesel. I leave early to get there early, and I waste half an hour here. And to top it all off, they don't accept debit cards, only cash. Thank goodness it's an ACA station.
